one_line_description.value: iPayX is a forensic FX audit platform that detects hidden bank FX spreads against mid-market benchmark rates and returns structured audit scores via REST API and an MCP server.
one_line_description.quote: Detect hidden bank spreads vs mid-market benchmark on any currency transaction.

api_breadth.value: REST, small surface (~3-4 endpoints: single audit, batch document audit, rates lookup), read-write; batches of up to 50 transactions per request
api_breadth.quote: Audit a batch of parsed transactions (e.g. exported from QuickBooks, Xero, Sage, or your CSV).

access_notes.value: Free signup tier with 3 lifetime audits ($0); API keys (prefix ipx_live_) are generated from the /developers page in the dashboard. Pricing positions signed reports and 'production-grade API' as upsells: Credit Pack 100 for $99 one-time or Unlimited at $299/mo. Plan soft monthly limits: Starter 1,000 / Pro 10,000 / Enterprise unmetered. Banks and institutions are routed to contact sales for FINTRAC-signed reports. Not explicit whether free-tier accounts can mint production keys.
access_notes.quote: Soft monthly limits apply per plan: Starter 1,000 / Pro 10,000 / Enterprise unmetered.

rate_limits.value: Per API key on a rolling 60-second window; HTTP 429 'rate_limit_exceeded' when exceeded (no numeric request cap published). Soft monthly limits: Starter 1,000 / Pro 10,000 / Enterprise unmetered.
rate_limits.quote: Rate limits are enforced per API key on a rolling 60-second window.

webhooks.quote: Subscribe to `audit.completed` events to power Zapier triggers, n8n workflows, or your own Slack alerts.

api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.value: Responses include an `api_version` field set to "v1" and endpoints are versioned under /v1; no deprecation or sunset policy is documented in the fetched pages.

verdict_reason: iPayX publishes a documented REST API (OpenAPI 3.1, Bearer auth, signed webhooks) plus a vendor-operated MCP server. API keys are self-serve from the developer dashboard after a free signup, and the pricing page lists a $0 free tier. The surface is narrow (FX audit/rates only) and production-grade access is a paid upsell, but credentials do not require sales contact or review.
main_blocker: Narrow FX-audit-only API; free tier capped at 3 lifetime audits with production-grade access paid
open_questions: Unclear whether free-tier accounts can mint production `ipx_live_` keys: pricing says 'Upgrade to signed reports or production-grade API' while /developers/sandbox says keys are generated from /developers once signed in.

Possible OAuth2 support is only implied by an 'OAuth2 apps' phrase in a 'coming soon' integrations list on the API docs page; documented API auth is Bearer token only, and no OAuth scopes are documented.
No official SDK languages appear in the fetched pages; a home-page search snippet mentioned 'REST API + SDKs' but the home page was not included in SOURCES.
Pricing tiers conflict between pages: /pricing lists Free / Credit Pack 100 ($99) / Unlimited ($299/mo), while /developers/sandbox references plans Starter 1,000, Pro 10,000 and Enterprise unmetered.
No separate sandbox/test environment or test-mode keys are documented; /developers/sandbox describes live `ipx_live_` keys against https://api.ipayx.ai/v1.
No numeric per-minute request cap is published; only a rolling 60-second window and HTTP 429 rate_limit_exceeded.
No deprecation/sunset policy documented; the iPayX API Terms page seen in search results is marked DRAFT and was not captured in SOURCES.
Composio catalog search for 'iPayX' returns zero toolkits, so no toolkit exists to build on today.
